questions: May a successful placement or replay return M04.name even though it is text supplied by the caller?
Must M06 repeat the requested source_id, or must all answers omit caller-supplied text?

Does the ban on caller-supplied text apply to every answer, only to refusal details, or to untyped diagnostic text? The first sentence forbids the request `name` and `source_id` that M04 and M06 require successful answers to carry, while the next sentence permits file names.

precedent.topic: Source, representation, precision, normalization, and read-count semantics of PublicationMark.marked_at
quotes:
The system clock is the one source of the current time, declared as `rules.time_source_policy`
   and reaching code through `system_clock_backend` as the operation `utc_now`.

Only a mark reads it, once, after the token, the request form and the identifiers are accepted and
   before the connection is examined or the project lock is taken. A mark refused before that point does
   not read it. A mark refused after it, and a replayed mark, have read it and write nothing. Scan, delivery
   and the health answer never read it.

The current time is a `datetime` in UTC without an offset, with microsecond precision and no
   rounding, written in ISO 8601 form as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, followed by `.` and six digits when
   the microseconds are not zero, with no offset. Every instant of a record and an answer is written
   so. It sets `marked_at`.
precedent.why: A7 identifies the clock authority, fixes the single sampling point and read count, and specifies the exact UTC-naive microsecond representation and serialization.

quotes: - INV-11: answers of scan, place, mark and a refusal contain neither the folder path, the store path nor the state path (`test_the_api_scans_and_places_without_showing_server_paths`), and the generated service has no Portal client, no outbound HTTP dependency and no Portal credential setting. An uppercase or unhyphenated project id and a body that is not the request form each answer 422 with `invalid_request`, no answer repeats what the caller sent (`test_a_malformed_request_is_refused_as_invalid_request`), and every refusal code answers its entries of `REFUSAL_STATUS` and `REFUSAL_DETAIL` (`test_each_refusal_answers_its_status_and_detail`).

judgement.rule:
**Член перечисления** note называет его именем рядом с адресом перечисления:
`the EXPENSE_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction`. Имя — то, которое пишет
emitter моделей и которое получает генератор: имя из `member_names`, иначе
верхнее написание значения (`expense.create` → `EXPENSE_CREATE`, `pending` →
`PENDING`). Имя есть у каждого члена. Значение допустимо только как дополнение к
имени: `the EXPENSE_CREATE member (value expense.create) of = models.AuditAction`.
Член, названный одним значением, — нарушение: значение с точкой или дефисом не
является именем ни одного члена, генератор пишет только имена
(`AuditAction.EXPENSE_CREATE`), и валидатор отклоняет такую note
(`note_enum_member_by_value`).

topics.topic: Define refusal-check precedence for scan and mark
questions: After authentication, in what order does scan check its project-id/body form, the connections file, the project connection, and the photo folder?
For mark, what is the order among request-form/project-id validation, connection checks, source-id validation, project locking, placement lookup, and publication-conflict checks?
After token validation, in what order do project-id and body validation, connection lookup, source-id validation and operation-specific checks run for scan and mark?

quotes:
| Step | Scan | Delivery | Mark |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1, API | token | token | token |
| 2, API | project id | request form, project id | request form, project id, `photo_id` |
| 3 | connection | connection | source id |
| 4 | photo folder | photo folder | clock |
| 5 | observe the folder, read records | source id | connection |
| 6 | | take the lock | take the lock |
| 7 | | existing placement: replay | placement exists |
| 8 | | read the named file once, check it, prepare, store the image, write the record | existing mark, or write the mark |
| 9 | | release the lock | release the lock |

A scan takes no lock. Only a mark reads the clock. The connections file is read once, at the connection
step.
judgement.why: The later module text gives the complete ordered check sequence for scan and mark, including source-id validation, connection access, clock reading, locking, placement lookup and conflict handling.

judgement.divergence: One test implementation checks only declared clients, dependencies and settings and can miss a Portal call made through a standard-library network facility; another traps outbound network activity and detects it, which the generated-service test suite and Portal operator notice.
judgement.why: INV-11 prohibits every Portal call, but its Required-tests item specifies only structural absences and does not say that direct or indirect outbound calls must be detected.
